context.purpose: Create editable Godot projects and scenes from declared primitives, materials, lights, cameras and supported glTF/PNG inputs. Named groups assemble static geometry with local transforms and verified world bounds.
context.assumptions: Godot 4.x; metres, explicit transforms and intrinsic YXZ Euler rotation semantics. Resources must remain with the project. Preview rendering needs an available graphics environment.
context.constraints: No arbitrary GDScript; only trusted generated project/orbit scripts. Bounded self-contained glTF subset. No live reverse synchronisation or universal material preservation.
context.inspection: Inspect fresh-process scene node membership, transforms, bounds, material/light settings and optional decoded PNG preview. Headless case acceptance does not qualify graphical rendering.
context.recovery: UNSUPPORTED_UNITS requires metres. Correct missing materials/resources and unsupported glTF features; preserve build/reopen logs. Use headless acceptance when preview graphics are unavailable.

lifecycle.timeout: Each native process is bounded by the runner timeout; conformance adds an independent wall-clock watchdog.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation retains partial evidence. Pre-launch cancellation is tested separately from shared in-flight cleanup.
lifecycle.logs: Fresh run directory retains authored input, effective plan, native submissions/stdout/stderr, publications and verification evidence.
lifecycle.verification: Check fresh scene readback against independently computed primitive bounds/transforms and declared node/material values; verify project/resource membership and bytes.
